name: Rising Causeway V2 · Difficulty 3 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Raise the red bridge, set the yellow stair high toward the far ledge, and prime the blue spring. Each deliberate drive or aim control advances one fixed action step; waiting leaves the visible architecture unchanged. Drive onto it, then aim and release into the moving delivery bay. The spring adds forward and sideways momentum; wheels cannot steer in air. Dotted tracks show recent action-step motion and the separate chart rows announce six seconds of spring position, bay centre at x = 28, and crosswind acceleration, with labelled physical scales. A fall, abandonment, or incomplete certification ends this attempt. After failure, TRY AGAIN starts a fresh attempt; earlier failures remain recorded.
